combo_label: Things That Beep × Birds & Birdwatching × Heists & Capers

entries.clue: Barrier arm that bleeps you through, or barks if your ticket is stale
Iridescent squabbler that masses in thousands to swirl in shapes above a pier
Steel-doored room the whole plan revolves around
Kidnappers' asking price, payable in unmarked bills
Ping. Pause. Ping. A submarine asking the dark whether anyone is out there.
Long night in a parked car with cold coffee, watching the door
Pied car-park sprinter whose rear end never once stops bobbing up and down
Lake diver that courts face to face, rearing up breast to breast with weed held out
Front-step button that chimes and instantly summons the dog.
Kitchen rumbler that clicks, chirps, and refuses to boil while you watch it.
